_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread

_similar.name: Fresh Fruit Platter with Dip
_similar.description: A colorful and refreshing fruit platter served with a creamy vanilla pudding dip, optionally flavored with Grand Marnier.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups milk (or a combination of 1 cup milk and ½ cup sour cream)
1 Tbsp Grand Marnier (or other favorite liquor/liqueur), optional
Assorted fresh fruit (e.g., strawberries, bananas, grapes, apple slices, orange slices, melon)

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare the vanilla pudding according to the package instructions using either 1½ cups of milk or the specified combination of milk and sour cream.
Mix equal parts of the prepared pudding and Cool Whip until well blended.
If using, add Grand Marnier or other liquor/liqueur and blend well into the pudding mixture.
Chill the dip in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
Arrange a selection of fresh fruit on a platter, alternating between contrasting colors for visual appeal.
Serve the chilled dip alongside the fresh fruit platter.

_similar.keywords: fresh fruit platter, vanilla pudding dip, Cool Whip, Grand Marnier, healthy appetizer

_similar.name: Nacho Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and flavorful dip made with cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning, topped with salsa, cheese, and chopped vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix until smooth.
Spread the mixture in a large glass pan.
Spread salsa sauce over the cream cheese layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the salsa layer.
Add chopped red pepper, green pepper, and tomato on top.
Serve with baked nacho chips.

_similar.keywords: nacho dip, creamy dip, taco seasoning, salsa dip
